title: Head Of DevOps
content:
We're looking for an impact-driven, experienced Head Of DevOps

As a Head of DevOps, you will be leading a team of experienced DevOps engineers in a serverless environment.

Qualifications:
- +5 years as DevOps Engineer/SRE
- +3 years as DevOps/SRE/Platform Engineering manager
- Extensive knowledge of AWS
- Good understanding and experience working with IAC (Infrastructure as Code) systems
- Experience with CI/CD best practices
- Working with version control systems (Git, GitHub)
- Experience with Database management (MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB)
- Experience configuring and automating monitoring tools (DataDog preferred)
- Security, Quality, and compliance knowledge

Bonus Points:
- Experience with serverless architecture
- Experience with FinOps tools, Budget planning and cost monitoring
- Experience with Service catalog/Developer portal (Backstage, Port, Cortex)
- Experience in managing managers

A day in the life:
- Lead a large and growing team of DevOps Engineers
- Work closely with 200+ Engineers at Melio
- Design and deploy scalable, secured, and highly available cloud infrastructure using AWS services
- Continuous improvement of CI/CD processes of the company
- Improve the development cycle and Developer Experience (DevX)

title: Backend Platform Engineering Manager
content:
